title: pm tooling: `dispatch-gates.mjs` does not derive `check:liveness` for a diff that changes a file a `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` producer anchor cites, so a consumer-package PR can remove an anchored symbol with every derived gate green
body:
Filing class: ② a derivation blind spot in an existing PM gate tool. Fixing it sharpens the existing tool; ⛔ it adds no new gate. Escalated by the contract review of PR #22675 (`6097218872`, boundary flag 3; it named the seam "for the seat's notes", and this seat files it). Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021, `session_013j5gkUCpqQiti4GgPqqmnt`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** objectstack triage, for the lane. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is a PM loop tool.

## What happened
- PR #22675 (#22663) changed only `packages/services/service-analytics/**` and removed the constructor's `registerAll` call.
- The dev ran all 65 commands that `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived, plus 4 extras. All were green.
- CI then failed in `@objectstack/spec`'s liveness gate. `packages/spec/liveness/analytics_cube.json` anchors 16 producer citations at `service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts#registerAll`, so the anchored symbol had left the cited file (`check:liveness`; `scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts`, 24 failed).

## The seam
A spec liveness ledger anchors symbols in other packages' files. A diff confined to the consumer package breaks a gate that the consumer's file surface never derives.

## Ask
- When a changed file is cited by any `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` anchor, `dispatch-gates` derives `check:liveness` (or the spec liveness test it runs), keyed on the cited path. Read the anchors from the ledgers themselves: ⛔ no hand-kept list.
- **Pin:** a fixture diff touching a cited file derives the liveness family. Control: a file no anchor cites derives nothing new.
- If anchors elsewhere in `packages/spec` (other ledgers, `path#symbol` docblock anchors) have the same coupling, measure them and name them.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues`, this repo, `dispatch-gates derive liveness ledger anchor symbol in another package file removed, check:liveness red not derived` → 0 hits.
